purpose: Record immutable module lineage, bounded patch intent, pacing holds, and interrupted-activation facts without taking operational authority.

storage.shape: immutable hash-chained event files plus ephemeral exclusive writer lock
storage.concurrencyGuarantee: one local writer at a time; every append rechecks exact expected revision under the writer lock
storage.abandonedLockBehavior: hold and report; never steal automatically

authority.neutralIntake: Neutral Modular Intake remains inspect, quarantine, family, and compatibility authority.
authority.moduleFiles: Module Installer remains the only module file-write and install authority.
authority.verification: Verification Spine and specialist verifiers remain verification authorities; a pass is evidence only.
authority.recovery: Recovery Center remains snapshot, restore, and rollback authority.
authority.evidence: Evidence Retention remains append-only session-evidence authority.
authority.readiness: Workshop Needs Observatory remains readiness and gap authority.
authority.humanGate: Mike's explicit review, permission, confirmation, and promotion gates remain required.
